title: 加里奥·白石天际
description: 白金巨像加里奥立在宽广空庭，巨翼半收，石质身体与金边肩甲在强日光下形成庄重几何轮廓。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Galio is an immense pale petricite sentinel with a pointed horned head, enormous gold-trimmed shoulder plates, massive carved chest, thick stone limbs, and giant angular wings. Preserve his living-statue anatomy and material rather than representing a man in a suit. His eyes are steady, the stone surfaces intact, and the folded wings and grounded feet create a composed monumental silhouette without destruction.
art_direction.scene: Show him standing in an expansive empty city courtyard, wings half folded and hands relaxed away from the torso. A low perspective reveals the complete figure against distant simplified towers and a clear sky. Strong directional sun breaks ivory stone into hard wax-crayon planes, while long blue ground shadows express scale without rubble, crowds, or any battle activity.
art_direction.palette: petricite ivory, pale gold, cobalt shadow, warm gray
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
